credit_line: Spencer Museum of Art, The University of Kansas, Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation [1994] (94.66)
description: An abstract, grayish green form that resembles a tree trunk extends from the bottom to the top of the composition. A single, burgundy-colored leaf floats in the upper left side of the image. The objects are framed by a background rendered in various shades of yellow.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
